# Deskwisp

> Deskwisp is a Windows app that gives a business a team of AI agents ("bots") for its operations. Each bot works on its own cloud computer, can have its own email address and a voice, remembers the business, and handles tasks such as the inbox, invoices and payment follow-ups, sales follow-ups, reports and web research. You chat with the bots or call them, and they ask before they send, book or pay.

## Key facts

- Platform: Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit). Bots can also be reached in Telegram, Discord, Slack and by email.
- Each bot has: a cloud computer (watch it live or take over), an email address (Pro and Max), a voice you can call from the app, and a memory of your business. Its own phone number is coming soon.
- Safety: reading and research happen straight away; sending, creating and paying wait for the user's approval.
- How it differs from a chatbot such as ChatGPT: a chatbot answers in a chat window and leaves the work to you; Deskwisp bots do the task on their own computers, keep working while you step away, and remember your customers.

## Plans

- Free: $0. $1 of AI credit and 10 computer hours a month, 1 screen per bot, as many bots as you like.
- Pro: $29 a month. $10 of AI credit, 60 computer hours a month, 2 screens per bot, an email address for the main bot, share with 2 people.
- Max: $199 a month. $100 of AI credit, 300 computer hours a month, 4 screens per bot, up to 5 email addresses, share with up to 5 people.
